{{Quote|They arre called ''kroyies''.''"<br />"''Those birds?''"<br />"''Yes. Once they werre a prize food to the Wookiee people. Now even the poorr may eat them. ''Kroyies'' will come to those lights. Hunters therre await them.|[[Ralrracheen]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Kroyies''' were a large [[Bird/Legends|birdlike]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

Avian animals, the kroyies were hunted as a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] source by the natives of Kashyyyk, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. Kroyies lived in the high branches of [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|Wroshyr trees]] and were attracted to bright lights, causing the Wookiees to use powerful searchlights projected into the sky or clouds in order to catch them.<ref name="TCSWE" />
